integrity: Analytical proof based on regularized Hamiltonian polarization and monotone essential suprema; finite standard-library checks supplementary only. All primary source hypotheses reconstructed for the accepted claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats aligned multiplication-operator pairs only, with positive p,q,a+b almost everywhere; arbitrary pairs, nontrivial common kernels, quantum implementability and unbounded operator forms are excluded. A general older symplectic-similarity result might implicitly subsume the claim. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp boundedness and conditioning of simultaneous Williamson forms for aligned multiplier pairs
